'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 PMT LS Careful Planning''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[PMT]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning|Endor-L-carefulplanning.gif|label=Careful Planning / We Have A Plan To Combat Them}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
